## [1.0.0-dev.2](https://github.com/vippium/brokenn-patches/compare/v1.0.0-dev.1...v1.0.0-dev.2) (2026-11-03)

### 🚀 Updated App Support

* drop JioHotstar 26.04.27.10 support ([4d3d26b](https://github.com/vippium/brokenn-patches/commit/4d3d26b22f3fdc19c7fee43c23019dae11a09dcc))

patches.name: Bypass signature check
patches.description: Bypasses app signature verification to allow API access.

patches.name: Enable all codecs
patches.description: Enables all video codecs (H265, VP9, AV1) and 4K resolution by bypassing blacklist and capability checks.

patches.name: Enable screen mirroring
patches.description: Allows playback while screen mirroring or HDMI is connected.

patches.name: Enable screenshots
patches.description: Removes screenshot and screen recording restrictions.

patches.name: Force HDR10
patches.description: Forces HDR10 and HDR10+ playback on compatible devices by bypassing blacklist and capability checks.

patches.name: Premium unlock
patches.description: Unlocks premium UI features, removes subscription nudges, and enables downloads.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Removes pre-roll, mid-roll, and live match video ads.
